title: Eleven Buttons and One Night
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：costume　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 costume 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my aunt ① made a costume with eleven buttons down the front, and she said the making was the whole of the rehearsal. The ② costume, meaning the clothes and not the part, was finished the night before and stayed unfinished; costume, she said, is the only thing in a play that is judged by how late it is ready.

Every ③ costume in that company had the same hook at the neck, and the ④ costume at the end, meaning the one she kept for the last act and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mended twice. Costume, my mother said, is nine parts hook and one part somebody willing to sew; my aunt said the sewing is the part that fills the night before.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the costume was the whole of the photograph, meaning the dress of the period and not the clothes on stage. The ⑥ costume, meaning the period dress and not any of that, is the only thing in a photograph that everybody dates and nobody asks about; costume, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both stage clothes and a period dress. She said the period dress is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ costume had become a line in an inventory, and the inventory had become an argument about the hook. The ⑧ costume of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in December, was one button and thirty years of sewing; costume, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to mend. He said the mending was never mentioned.

The ⑨ costume I remember is the one at the end, which she made in 1975 and is still described as the heaviest in the county. A ⑩ costume, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being worn; every costume, she said, is a period dress that has agreed to look like stage clothes. She said the period dress was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 戏服（指那套服装本身，与那个角色相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a costume 做一套戏服
D. n. 戏服（指那个剧团里每一套）
E. n. 戏服（指末尾那一套）
F. n. 服装；装束（指某一时代、地方的穿着）
G. n. 戏服（指清单里提到的那一套）
H. n. 服饰；装扮（抽象总称）

items.q: made a costume with eleven buttons down the front
The costume, meaning the clothes and not the part

answers.why: make a costume 意为“做一套戏服”，1961 年姑姑做了一套前襟钉了十一颗扣子的戏服。
costume 意为“戏服”，指那套服装本身而不是那个角色，它在演出前一晚才做好。
costume 指那个剧团里每一套戏服，每一套领口都是同样的钩子。
costume 指末尾那一套（她留给最后一幕的那一套），是唯一有人补过两次的。
costume 意为“服装、装束”，父亲说那身时代装束就是那张照片的全部，指的是某一时代的穿着而不是舞台上的戏服。
costume 为另一个义项，指某一时代的穿着而不是舞台上的戏服，是照片里人人都据此断代、却无人追问的东西。
costume 意为“戏服”，指清单里提到的那一套，到 1969 年这套戏服成了清单里的一行。
costume 意为“服饰、装扮”，姑姑十二月写道，整件事的服饰是一颗扣子三十年的缝制。
costume 意为“戏服”，我记得的是末尾那一套，她 1975 年做的，至今仍被说成全县最重的。
costume 为抽象总称，母亲说一套戏服是唯一会因为被穿上而变好的东西。
